batch.topic: A traveller requests a seat facing the direction of travel without requesting a window seat; preserve the distinction between preferences.
A rental agency returns a deposit after checking an item, not immediately when it is placed on the counter; a receipt confirms handover only.
A visitor can exchange a paper ticket for a wristband but must retain the ticket for a separately booked activity.
A road detour adds walking distance but does not require changing the destination; avoid inventing transport or accessibility guarantees.
